name: Korrilla Hearthflame
backstory: Korrilla Hearthflame is a gold dwarven agent of Raphael's. She can be encountered briefly in Act One and Act Two. She later moves to Sharess' Caress, the House of Hope and potentially in the Elfsong Tavern during Act Three.
